name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Lint (zero warnings)
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Typecheck
        run: pnpm typecheck

      - name: Unit tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm build

  compose-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Start postgres and redis
        run: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis --wait

      - name: Verify services are healthy
        run: |
          docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres pg_isready -U dispatch
          docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T redis redis-cli ping | grep -q PONG

      - name: Tear down
        if: always()
        run: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml down -v

{
  "name": "@mailpelican/api",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json",
    "dev": "tsx watch src/index.ts",
    "start": "node dist/index.js",
    "bootstrap": "tsx src/bootstrap.ts",
    "typecheck": "tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit",
    "test": "vitest run"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@mailpelican/config": "workspace:*",
    "@mailpelican/contracts": "workspace:*",
    "@mailpelican/db": "workspace:*",
    "@mailpelican/domain": "workspace:*",
    "@mailpelican/relays": "workspace:*",
    "@mailpelican/render": "workspace:*",
    "@hono/node-server": "^1.14.0",
    "@hono/zod-openapi": "^0.19.0",
    "drizzle-orm": "^0.43.1",
    "hono": "^4.7.7",
    "ioredis": "^5.6.0",
    "zod": "^3.24.3"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@mailpelican/queue": "workspace:*",
    "@mailpelican/testkit": "workspace:*",
    "@mailpelican/worker": "workspace:*",
    "@types/node": "^22.15.0",
    "tsx": "^4.19.3",
    "typescript": "^5.8.3",
    "vitest": "^3.1.0"
  }
}
